node.title: Integer original-weight line and small shared-terminal bounds
node.statement: Original MCA affine pair lines have integer population floor((R+1+h-e)/(d+1-t+h)) and weight bounded by min(m*(R-d+t),t+m*e) for constant direction, or min(m*(R-d+t),R+J+(m-1)*e) otherwise. Inside nonconstant defects charge each original coordinate once globally. Shared/pair dimension c<=3 terminals use constant rigidity or the minimum of determinant incidence and SAME-FIELD shared-carrier joint LIST times original per-pair weight. No source payment is assumed.
